label: broken

unstated.what: A new `init` keyword parameter on Representation.segments() so callers can request only content segments on reload; the instruction never mentions changing the segments() API or adding a parameter.
MPD constructor must accept a 'timelines' keyword argument used to carry segment-number state across manifest reloads, and MPD must expose a 'timelines' attribute
Representation.segments() must accept an 'init' keyword (init=False) that suppresses yielding the initialization segment
When a reloaded dynamic SegmentList has no new SegmentURLs, segments() must yield an empty list rather than repeating the existing ones
MPD constructor must accept a timelines argument (or expose timelines) to carry segment-number state across manifest reloads
segments() must support an init=False keyword to skip re-yielding the initialization segment on reload
Segment attributes: init/content booleans with exact semantics (init segment has init=True, content=True only for media segments) and num starting from startNumber=2

reasons: The instruction only asks that reloaded dynamic SegmentList manifests not re-yield already-downloaded segments, which the tests' filtering behaviour and use of pre-existing MPD timelines cover. The only unstated requirement is the new `init=False` keyword on segments(), which no engineer could infer from the issue text alone.

The instruction only asks that reloads of dynamic SegmentList manifests not re-yield downloaded segments, but the hidden tests drive this through a new 'timelines' state-passing argument to MPD and an 'init=False' kwarg on segments(), neither of which is named in the instruction; the empty-yield-on-no-new-segments contract is also only implied.

The tests require a timelines-passing mechanism on MPD construction, an init=False parameter on segments(), and specific Segment attribute semantics (init/content flags, numbering) — none of which are stated in the issue, though each is a fairly natural design choice for implementing the fix; the times attribute is not asserted so SegmentTimeline handling is not required.
